# Portable pip requirements for CPU_model_stable.
#
# Usage on a new machine:
#   conda activate ort  # optional, if you use conda
#   python -m pip install -r env/requirements.txt
#
# This file intentionally excludes machine-local wheels, PyTorch wheels, and
# vendor Ascend/NPU runtime packages. PyTorch is needed only for DLRM ONNX/data
# generation and legacy MLP baselines; install a platform-compatible PyTorch
# separately before running those paths.

numpy>=1.26
pandas>=2.2,<4.0
scipy>=1.11
scikit-learn>=1.4
joblib>=1.3
PyYAML>=6.0
matplotlib>=3.8
networkx>=3.2
tqdm>=4.66
psutil>=5.9
packaging>=23.0

# ONNX/ORT profiling and static graph utilities.
onnx>=1.16
onnxruntime>=1.18

# Optional baseline packages such as PyTorch/XGBoost/LightGBM/CatBoost are not
# required by the current mainline RF route and are deliberately not installed
# by default to keep migration deterministic across CPU architectures.
